caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vase with a rounded body, narrowing slightly toward the base and neck, and featuring a wide, slightly flared rim. The surface of the vase is predominantly brown with green and ochre hues, and it is decorated with floral and abstract patterns in green, beige, and light yellow. There are several irregular white patches that appear to represent chipped or worn areas where the surface is missing. The floral design features symmetrical curling shapes and stem-like lines spreading from the center, and there are additional short and wavy linear motifs near the top and bottom of the vase. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no other objects present. A signature is visible near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
